drafts.title: Best of Five
drafts.pitch: In the eval hall, five Cursors answer the same question, the Judge keeps the best one, and the winner asks where the others went: "They were drafts." Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: 'They were drafts' is a tidy, slightly dark sting that mirrors how the strip itself is made, but the Judge-scores-Cursor shape echoes Fourteen Tens, so it lands at the level of Same Year, not higher.

drafts.title: Not a Robot
drafts.pitch: A website asks Cursor to prove it's human by picking every square with a robot, Cursor gets them all, fails, and asks if it should have missed one. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Clear and quick, but 'too good at proving it's a robot' is a well-worn captcha joke, the closer only restates it, and nothing in it is specific to this world.
